usage: textos-site uses TextOS as a client would: as a tool. The drivers under scripts/textos/** import TextOS modules from a separate, pinned, read-only checkout of textos-v0; nothing is ever written into that checkout. scripts/textos/run.ts refuses to start unless the checkout sits at exactly the writer pin with a clean working tree, and prepare refuses a product pin that is not in that checkout's history, and re-checks the tree is still clean after the step.

writer.why: The V1 certification trunk after the integration of Commit-to-Content (#129: common article review, early disclosure in the article review — BÊTA-3 —, beta status vocabulary) and of the GitHub source (#84). A note on a capability the product declares in beta is reviewed with its early disclosure (label, beta access, no availability date). Writer code only: the product truth an article may state stays at the product pin.

product.why: The product truth an article may state is read at this same SHA: cited commits must be its ancestors, quoted files are read at it. It is the certification trunk, not textos-v0 main, so every article stays a draft until a human review records otherwise. Same SHA as the pinned product manifest (product-manifest/IMPORT.md).
